question: Read the statistic names and numeric class bitmasks for user calls, session logical reads, physical reads, redo size, parse count (total), parse count (hard), and user commits from V$STATNAME joined to V$SYSSTAT by statistic#. Return only name and class, not live values. Explain whether CLASS is a bitmask and whether system statistics are CDB-wide in a CDB.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT n.name, n.class FROM v$statname n JOIN v$sysstat s ON s.statistic# = n.statistic# WHERE n.name IN ('user calls', 'session logical reads', 'physical reads', 'redo size', 'parse count (total)', 'parse count (hard)', 'user commits') ORDER BY n.name

question: Read the statistic names and numeric class bitmasks for user calls, session logical reads, physical reads, redo size, parse count (total), parse count (hard), and user commits from V$SYSSTAT. Return only name and class, not live values. Explain whether CLASS is a bitmask and whether system statistics are CDB-wide in a CDB.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT name, class FROM v$sysstat WHERE name IN ('user calls', 'session logical reads', 'physical reads', 'redo size', 'parse count (total)', 'parse count (hard)', 'user commits') ORDER BY name
